subject: English
passage: Although several technically advanced civilizations had developed mosaic art long before the Romans ______ it was the Romans who transformed the medium from a decorative craft into a widespread form of artistic expression across the ancient world.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is punctuation use between a dependent clause and a main clause. This choice correctly uses a comma to mark the boundary between the subordinate clause beginning with "Although" ("Although…did") and the main clause ("it was…world").

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because a semicolon can't be used in this way to join a dependent clause ("Although…did") and a main clause ("it was…world"). A semicolon is conventionally used to join two independent clauses.
